tweetText: Autonomous AI systems are now being tested in real-world settings like warehouses and public spaces. This raises important questions about whether existing AI regulations adequately address these new physical challenges. via AI News.

DuckDuckGo app installs surged by 30% as users push back against Google's AI-driven search changes. This shift highlights a growing demand for alternatives in digital privacy and choice. via TechCrunch AI
OpenRouter's valuation has surged to $1.3B after raising $113M in a Series B round. This rapid growth shows that the future with multiple AI models is becoming a reality. via TechCrunch AI

A startup called Human Archive is paying gig workers in India to wear camera caps and collect data for training AI and robots. This could help bridge the gap in the gig economy and enhance global robotics development. via TechCrunch AI

Universal Music Group and TikTok have renewed their agreement to tackle unauthorized AI music. This partnership highlights the ongoing battle to protect artists' rights in the evolving digital landscape. via TechCrunch AI

Pope Leo referenced The Lord of the Rings in his encyclical on AI, cleverly calling out tech billionaires who misunderstand Tolkien's themes. This highlights the cultural disconnect between tech leaders and the deeper moral implications of their creations. via WIRED AI

The Vatican invited Anthropic to present at the Pope's AI encyclical launch, highlighting a unique partnership between the Church and tech. This collaboration could impact how faith and technology intersect in the future. via WIRED AI

Pope Leo XIV's first encyclical warns against the concentration of AI power among a few companies. This matters because it raises concerns about ethics and control in technology's future. via WIRED AI

AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw have shaken up the tech world, sparking a major transformation in computing. This shift could redefine industries and how we interact with technology. via WIRED AI.
A new quiz reveals which jobs might be at risk from AI and which ones could survive. Understanding this can help people prepare for the future of work. via WIRED AI
